evidence.excerpt: 列/columns: [1] 前連結会計年度 (自 2021年4月1日 至 2022年3月31日) [restated] / [2] 当連結会計年度 (自 2022年4月1日 至 2023年3月31日); 行/rows (values shown as [1]/[2], JPY_million): 精密加工装置(Precision Processing Machines)=154,560 / 180,741; 精密加工ツール(Precision Processing Tools)=62,621 / 62,336; その他(Other)=36,599 / 41,057; 売上高合計(Total net sales)=253,781 / 284,135 ; (注) 第１四半期連結会計期間より、従来「その他」に含めておりました一部の製品は、製品分類の見直しを行ったため、「精密加工装置」及び「精密加工ツール」に区分して表示しております。この表示方法の変更を反映させるため、前連結会計年度について注記の組替えを行っております。この結果、前連結会計年度において、組替え前に比べ「精密加工装置」が10,651百万円増加、「精密加工ツール」が4,146百万円増加し、「その他」が14,797百万円減少しております。 (restatement note: products previously in 'Other' reclassified into Machines/Tools for the FY2021 comparative column; vs. originally-reported FY2021 -- Machines up 10,651m, Tools up 4,146m, Other down 14,797m) [The English gloss uses direction words because the page states the change as 増加/減少 beside positive figures; it never prints a signed number, and the three movements net to zero: 10,651 + 4,146 = 14,797.]

notes: DISCO's Precision Processing Machines (精密加工装置) product-group revenue, FY2022 (2022-04-01 to 2023-03-31), from the 'Disaggregation of revenue from contracts with customers' note (收益認識関係) of the disco_fy2022_yuho_jp annual securities report, current-year column. Bundles dicing saws, laser saws, grinders, polishers and surface planers with no further split anywhere in this filing (see disco_precision_processing_machines scope definition and the handback report's conclusion on the dicing-vs-grinding question). This exact figure recurs, unchanged, as the prior-year comparative column of the following year's annual securities report (corroboration only; not independently re-registered).

notes: RESTATED FY2021 (2021-04-01 to 2022-03-31) figure for Precision Processing Machines (精密加工装置), from the prior-year comparative column of disco_fy2022_yuho_jp's revenue-disaggregation note (physical p.91). DISCO's own dated note on this page states that from Q1 of FY2022, products previously classified under 'Other' were reclassified into 'Precision Processing Machines' and 'Precision Processing Tools', and gives the exact delta against the as-originally-reported FY2021 figure (disco_fy2021_yuho_jp, physical p.77): Precision Processing Machines +10,651m. This is a genuine product-classification restatement, not a transcription correction or a plain corroborating restatement of an unchanged fact, so it is registered as its own observation with revision_of pointing to DISCO-MACH-REV-FY2021 -- the same convention naura_2023.json uses for its N2023-CR/N2023-CR-R pair. Total revenue is unaffected (253,781 million yen both before and after restatement), so no restated Total observation exists.
